title: Player sheet: token and economy tooltips
description: The player sheet's token line is now just the three numbers (tactic, fleet, strategy) joined by diamonds, and the token, trade goods and commodities values explain themselves on hover or keyboard focus.

shots.heading: At rest
shots.caption: TG and Comm stay compact; the old 'Tokens: a/b/c' label became '3 ◆ 3 ◆ 2' (tactic, fleet, strategy).

shots.heading: Token line tooltip
shots.caption: Hover or focus the numbers: 'Tactic 3 · Fleet 3 · Strategy 2'. The element also carries an aria-label for screen readers.

shots.heading: Trade goods tooltip
shots.caption: TG shows 'Trade goods' on hover or focus.

shots.heading: Commodities tooltip
shots.caption: Comm shows 'Commodities' on hover or focus.
